newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong Chinese Bank FRCD raised to US$135 mln.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong Chinese Bank FRCD raised to US$135 mln.

text.p: Hong Kong Chinese Bank's floating rate certificates of deposit issue has been increased to US$135 million from US$100 million, arrangers said.
The five-year issue had put and call options at the end of years three and four, they said.
The certificates were priced at par to float at 50 basis points over the three-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers is 68 basis points.
Jardine Fleming Bank, Societe Generale Asia and Schroders Asia are arrangers.
Fifteen international financial institutions in addition to the arrangers joined the transaction.
